turns.reply:
I hear you, Ashley, and I know how stressful it is when you're on a tight deadline and feeling that pressure. 

But I have to be straight with you: 800 calories a day is a crash diet. At that level, your body won't just burn fat—it will burn muscle, sap your energy, and leave you feeling absolutely exhausted. It's also incredibly difficult to get the essential nutrients and the 130g of protein you need to protect your lean muscle. 

Even with three weeks to go, we can make real progress and help you feel much more comfortable in your clothes without putting your body through that kind of stress. 

What if we look at a realistic, aggressive but safe deficit for these next three weeks instead?
